Brown Act

Agendas are drafted to accurately state what the legislative body is being asked to consider. The legislative body can
take action on "all items" listed on the agenda and be in compliance with the open meeting laws. Under the Brown
Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special
circumstances exist. The governing body may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for
consideration at a future meeting.

SUBJECT:  CITIZENS  ADVISORY  COMMITTEE  ANNUAL  ACTION  PLAN  WORKSHOP
PRESENTED  BY  THE  HOUSING  MANAGER.

PURPOSE: The putapose of this item is to inform the Citizen's Advisory Committee  (CAC) of the
purpose of the Annual Action Plan, public service, and non-public service projects application process
requirements. The CAC will receive Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) application
packets submitted for public services for their review, prior to the February 21, 2024, CAC meeting.

FISCAL  IMPACT:  No fiscal  impact.

ANALYSIS:  This workshop  is being  held to provide  information  to the CAC  committee  members
about the Annual  Action  Plan requirements  and public  service  grants  review  process.  This workshop
will  provide  new members  the opportunity  to learn about the planning  and review  process  of the
CDBG  prograt'n.  It is also a good refresher  course to existing  legislative  body  members  and staff.
The workshop  will  be open to the public  in person  at the City  of South  Gate City  Hall.

BACKGROUND:  The City,  as an entitlement  city,  receives  CDBG  'funds  on an annual  basis from
the U.S.  Department  of  Housing  and Urban  Development  (HUD)  to carg  out  a wide  range  of
con'irnunity  development  activities,  which  benefit  low-income  residents  and build  and develop  strong
and resilient neighborhoods.

The City's  adopted  Citizen  Participation  Plan, which  is a component  of the Consolidated  Plan, requires
that members  for the CAC  be appointed  by the City  Council.  The CAC  is an advisoiy  committee  to
the City Council.  The City  Council,  by State law, is the responsible  legislative  body in matters  relating
to the Consolidated  Plan and the Consolidated  Plan process.  The CAC  may be involved  in the review
and evaluation  of the programs  carried  with  CDBG  funds.  As  appropriate,  progress  or evaluation
repoits  concerning  the grant  may  be reviewed  by the CAC  and recommendations  concerning  tlie
reports  made to the City  Council.

RECOMMENDED  ACTIONS:  It is recommended  that the Citizen  Advisory  Committee  receive  and
file the presentation  regarding  the purpose  of the Annual  Action  Plan, public  service,  and non-public
service  projects  application  process  requirements.

Over the course  of three fiscal  years,  Califoniia  Latino  Leadership  received  $60,165  in CDBG-CV
funds to implement  a paid college  student  internship  program.  To date they have expended
$43,972.50.  They have provided  paid internships  to 16 eligible  South  Gate college  students.

Compatior  provides  free mental  health  services  to South  Gate residents.  They  received  an American
Rescue Plan Act (ARPA)  allocation  of $200,000  per year for FY 2023/24  and FY 2024/25.
Compatior  has expended  $27,931.18  and assisted  32 eligible  South  Gate residents  with  mental  health
services  for a total  of 212 duplicated  sessions  during  the first  quarter  of FY 2023/24.

BACKGROUND:  The  City  of  South  Gate  (City),  as an entitlement  city,  receives  Community
Development  Block  Grant  (CDBG)  and HOME  Investment  Partnership  (HOME)  Program  funds  on
an annual  basis from  the U.S. Department  of Housing  and Urban  Development  (HUD)  to carg  out a
wide range of community  development  activities  to benefit  low-income  residents.  On an annual  basis
the City  receives an estimated  $1.4 million  of which  15% or approximately  $210,000  may be used for
public  services.
